depicted_variant: Gogfran sebagai raksasa humanoid Welsh yang keluar dari caer di atas sungai.

visual_requirements.description: Raksasa humanoid satu kepala dua mata dua lengan dua kaki; tubuh tertutup pakaian buram penuh, tanpa tanduk/sayap.
Caer di atas sungai Aber Ysgyr, Brycheiniog; ukuran raksasa dibanding benteng.

aura: Skala raksasa mendominasi caer saat melangkah dari gerbang (gogfran-gawr-c02, gogfran-gawr-c15).
artistic_choices: Pakaian wol penuh, usia dewasa, rambut/beard, palet walnut/emas dan cahaya bulan editorial; tidak diklaim atribut tradisional.
Tidak ada kuasa terdokumentasi; ancaman/keagungan dari skala raksasa, langkah dan sudut kamera.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Gogfran Gawr, the giant father of Gwenhwyfar in Welsh tradition.
ANATOMY: one enormous HUMAN GIANT, one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs, rough wool tunic and full opaque cloak and trousers; no horns, wings or weapons. [gogfran-gawr-c02,gogfran-gawr-c09]
MOMENT: stride out through the stone caer gateway and lean down toward the viewer, one powerful hand braced on the gate lintel, cloak dragged by his decisive step, intense commanding gaze.
POWER: no documented power; overwhelming physical giant size, motion and light only; no magic.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle at riverbank level; giant shoulders tower above the caer gate, stone fort as small scale reference; giant dominates whole frame, face unmistakable at thumbnail.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low moon source, deep walnut shadows, antique gold rim light, ordinary disturbed grit around his feet.
SURFACE: weathered wool, coarse hair, lined human skin and rough wet stone.
SETTING: the caer above the river at Aber Ysgyr near Aber Hodni in Brycheiniog. [gogfran-gawr-c15]
MOOD: awe-inspiring towering giant, active and imposing, never ordinary man standing for portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, glyphs, lettering, logo, border, watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime design; no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons. One square PNG at least1024x1024.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native dan200px diperiksa: Uji Sangar7/7 ya. Giant melangkah keluar gerbang, bahu di atas lintel dan kaki besar menimbulkan cipratan biasa; subjek dominan. Satu kepala2mata2lengan2kaki sesuai humanoid, pakaian buram. Tiada efek gaib, teks/glyph/gore atau desain popculture.

root_visual_review.notes: Robed giant leaning on a fort wall above the river, its gate reaching only his knee; one head, two arms.
